# Arms Warrior — what the bots run

**Recommendation (what the bots run).** Endgame build (level 60), 35/16/0 — respec at level 60. The decision loop walks 67 rules in ascending priority and executes the first whose condition is true. The party fixtures place this spec on level 38 (1 member), level 48 (1 member). [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/warrior/arms/talents.yaml`, `rotation.yaml`]

**Measured in round 155** (amp-6's per-spec table). No measured numbers for this spec: it has no row in the round-155 table, which lists the 14 specs with boss-fight data [measured].

**This page is the bots' half.** It records what our party bots actually run for this spec — the level-60 build and the level-by-level order, the rule firing order the decision loop walks, the kit bands, the round-155 measurement and the recorded deviations. The hand-written guide for this spec is [arms.md](./arms.md).

## How the bots play it

On every decision tick the loop walks the rules in ascending `priority`, executes the first one whose condition is true and skips the rest of that tick. The groups below are a reading aid; the priority numbers are the real order. Level is the rule's own `level_min` — the first level it can fire.

### Single target

- **29 — Slam** (`A16b-slam-before-execute`) — level 60+ · intent `filler` · spell 1464
  - **When:** (the resident has Battle Stance or the resident has Berserker Stance); in melee range; target health below 20%; the resident is not moving; at least 75 rage.
  - **Why:** HO-TKB-PLAY-233 (CONTESTED, as A03-execute): 'slam-exe-swing' -- at high rage in the execute phase cast Slam first and Execute after it.
  - Sources: [arms-melee-dps.md § Single-target rotation (raid) (L76)](../../../synthesis/classes/warrior/arms-melee-dps.md#L76); [arms-melee-dps.md § Common mistakes (L106)](../../../synthesis/classes/warrior/arms-melee-dps.md#L106); [arms-melee-dps.md § Corrections and supersessions (L118)](../../../synthesis/classes/warrior/arms-melee-dps.md#L118); [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/warrior/arms/rotation.yaml`; supporting: `doc research/db-queries/tkbplay-233.result.txt`; `doc handoffs/tkb-play-233.md`].

## Situational notes from the rule notes

Every sentence below is copied from a rule's own note (the rule id is in front of it) and mentions a situation the rule exists for. Rest, food and drink rules are left out here; their items are in the band table above.

- **A00u-elemental-stone — Apply Elemental Sharpening Stone:** HO-TKB-PLAY-205 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18: buff food, elixirs, oils and stones in use): Elemental Sharpening Stone (item 18262, required level 50), sharpening stone (enchant 22756, edged weapons only), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and the buff or enchant is missing (or under 5 min for an enchant), so it is also re-applied after a death or a swap. The spec's own guide page names it (line 286); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **A00u-mongoose — Use Elixir of the Mongoose:** HO-TKB-PLAY-205 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18: buff food, elixirs, oils and stones in use): Elixir of the Mongoose (item 13452, required level 46), elixir or potion (aura 17538 while it lasts), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and the buff or enchant is missing (or under 5 min for an enchant), so it is also re-applied after a death or a swap. The spec's own guide page names it (line 297); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **A00u-juju-power — Use Juju Power:** HO-TKB-PLAY-205 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18: buff food, elixirs, oils and stones in use): Juju Power (item 12451, required level 0), elixir or potion (aura 16323 while it lasts), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and the buff or enchant is missing (or under 5 min for an enchant), so it is also re-applied after a death or a swap. The spec's own guide page names it (line 297); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **A00u-mighty-rage — Use Mighty Rage Potion:** On a boss pull at low rage: the potion energizes rage (spell 17528, Effect energize) and the fury guide's core kit names it (line 28).
- **A00u-juju-flurry — Use Juju Flurry:** A haste buff (spell 16322, 60 s item cooldown); the guide names it for this spec; cast on a boss.
- **A00u-elixir-of-giants — Use Elixir of Giants:** HO-TKB-PLAY-340 (consumables pass, orchestrator ruling 2026-10-18: every page-recommended consumable a pioneer can get at its level gets a rule, so the kit generator carries it): Elixir of the Giants (item 9206, required level 38, spell and aura 11405, +Strength, one hour, elixir category 79). "Juju Power and Elixir of the Giants do not stack ...
- **A01-battle-stance — Battle Stance:** Stance first: Overpower, Charge, Sweeping Strikes and Retaliation carry stances 65536 and are refused outside it (SpellEntry::GetErrorAtShapeshiftedCast).
- **A02-pummel-t1 — Pummel:** Same when and same spell; the view takes only a caster whose interruptible cast is one of the listed ids, so the kick goes to a heal, then a fear, charm, polymorph, stun or sleep, then a summon or channel, then the nearest caster (the plain rule, which keeps nukes and fillers). 193 adds the Atal'ai camp casts the boss rows lack: Heal 11642, Sleep 12098, Summon 12151 (DB, docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-192.result.txt).
- **A02-pummel-t2 — Pummel:** HO-TKB-PLAY-192 and 193 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator, p1-loop v41 casting list): the ranked version of A02-pummel, tier 2 of 3 (rank 2, fears, charms, polymorphs, stuns and sleeps; 14 ids). Same when and same spell; the view takes only a caster whose interruptible cast is one of the listed ids, so the kick goes to a heal, then a fear, charm, polymorph, stun or sleep, then a summon or channel, then the nearest caster (the plain rule, which keeps nukes and fillers).
- **A02-pummel-t3 — Pummel:** HO-TKB-PLAY-192 and 193 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator, p1-loop v41 casting list): the ranked version of A02-pummel, tier 3 of 3 (rank 2, summons and interruptible channels; 14 ids). Same when and same spell; the view takes only a caster whose interruptible cast is one of the listed ids, so the kick goes to a heal, then a fear, charm, polymorph, stun or sleep, then a summon or channel, then the nearest caster (the plain rule, which keeps nukes and fillers).
- **A02-pummel — Pummel:** Interrupt; 10 rage, categoryRecoveryTime 10000, stances 327680 (Battle and Berserker), so legal in the stance A01 keeps. A bot only interrupted the mob it had selected, so with the party on another mob nobody stopped the heal or the cast (Jammal'an's Healing Wave, the Hateforge cleric's Greater Heal).
- **A02a-hamstring — Hamstring:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): Hamstring a runner (target.fleeing): "Hamstring a mob that runs" / "Hamstring a runner" (warrior/leveling.md L100, L115). Above Execute: snare the runner first.
- **A13i-intimidating-shout — Intimidating Shout:** ALONE only (`not (party.lowest_hp_pct >= 0)`: a fear in a group or a dungeon pulls the room, the orchestrator's condition), with two or more attackers within 8 yd, under half health, and no other hostile within 30 yd that is not already on the warrior (`enemies_within(30) <= enemies_engaged_within(30)`, WA04b-fear-second's gate), so the fleeing mobs bring no friends.
- **A03-execute — Execute:** The 20 percent gate is the core's own: the row carries targetAuraState 2 = AURA_STATE_HEALTHLESS_20_PERCENT, so target.hp_pct < 20 restates the condition the server checks rather than adding one.
- **A04-overpower — Overpower:** The dodge window it really needs is not in vocabulary v2: the core gives the warrior a combo point on the victim's dodge and runs REACTIVE_OVERPOWER for 4000 ms, and the spell carries SPELL_ATTR_EX_ENABLE_AT_DODGE; there is no casterAuraState on the row despite what the vocabulary comment says. combo_points is filed for v3 (OQ-1800); until then the rule fires on cooldown and the core refuses it when the window is shut.
- **A09r-recklessness — Recklessness:** "From 50, add Recklessness on a dangerous elite or pull (the rule narrows it to bosses) (30 min cooldown, shared with Shield Wall and Retaliation)" (leveling.md L210, L203). It needs Berserker Stance, which this file holds only for Whirlwind (A06s switches in when Whirlwind is ready and rage >= 25; A01 goes back to Battle), so the rule tests aura_self(2458) and fires in that window, ahead of Whirlwind (62 < 64): on a BOSS target only (orchestrator ruling 2026-10-18: Retaliation shares the 30 minute cooldown and is not a dungeon rotation tool, so the elite and three-mob triggers are dropped), above half health.
- **A11-thunder-clap — Thunder Clap:** Attack-speed debuff on packs; 20 rage, stances 196608 (Battle and Defensive), 8 yd radius. cooldown_ready is the fix HO-P1-KB2-003 made for protection: the 4 s gate is a categoryRecoveryTime, invisible to the aura test. The guide for 1-9: "If a second mob joins, Thunder Clap once to slow both and kill one"; for 10-19: "On an accidental add: Demoralizing Shout -> Thunder Clap -> focus one mob; Hamstring a runner".
- **A12-battle-shout — Battle Shout:** Measured (same sample, alone): 5,010 Battle Shouts, 3,230 of them in combat at under 25 rage and 256 at 25-34: it competed for 10 rage with Rend and Heroic Strike (priority 87 ahead of both) 16 per cent of the rage spent; out of combat it is unchanged (10 rage, not eating).
- **A12a-demoralizing-shout — Demoralizing Shout:** HO-TKB-PLAY-066 (round 87, party B and C): Demoralizing Roar and Demoralizing Shout apply the same aura (MOD_ATTACK_POWER, aura 99) with different values (Roar rank 1 -31, Shout rank 1 -36, Roar 2 -51, Shout 2 -56), so the weaker is refused while the stronger is on the target and the guard `not aura_target(99)` (or 1160) stays true: the feral DPS druid cast Roar 68 times (10 rage each, 680 rage) under a warrior's Shout, every cast landing and no aura 99 ever appearing. The guard is now any Demoralizing aura of either spell (Roar 99, 1735, 9490; Shout 1160, 6190, 11554), on every Roar and Shout rule.
- **A10-sunder-armor — Sunder Armor:** Two independent parts of the archive agreeing is what carries this rule; the pin carries the mechanic: 10 rage (manaCost 100 in tenths), no cooldown, no stance mask, aura 22 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE) at effectBasePoints1 -91 to stackAmount 5, taught at 10 by the same Path of Defense quest chain that teaches Defensive Stance. HO-TKB-PLAY-075 (owner, solo audit of levels 10-20; HELD for a measured round): beyond the first stack only on an ELITE: `(aura_target_stacks(7386) < 1 or target.elite)`, the `target.ttd_ms >= 15000` term is gone.

## What the bots do not do (from the rule notes)

Sentences from the rules' notes that say what is deliberately not implemented, or that name an open question.

- **A00u-smoked-desert-dumplings:** "Only one food buff applies at a time; Power Mushroom equals Smoked Desert Dumpling and costs less" (warrior/fury.md L298); the Mushroom is a drop (an open question), the Dumpling is the guide's equal.
- **A03-execute:** The 60 is the low end of that range and a policy, not a measured value (open question in the handoff).
